name: Research Interview
description: Themes, quotes and insights from a user or research interview.
outline: State who was interviewed (by role, not by sensitive detail) and the goal of the interview if mentioned.
Group the insights into themes with a short heading each.
Support each theme with one or two verbatim quotes in quotation marks.
List pain points and unmet needs separately from positive feedback.
End with open questions worth exploring in the next interview.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Themes
### Onboarding feels long
> "I gave up at the third screen."
